title: An ended item keeps an active blocker, so ls --all --blocked lists finished work
outcome: An ended item keeps an active blocker, so ls --all --blocked lists finished work
acceptance: A recorded decision says whether ending an item (complete, cancel, supersede) retires its active blockers, or whether the blocked filter excludes ended work; the code, ls help, MCP description, docs and the engram-use skill follow it, with a test of ls --all --blocked on an item blocked before it ended

completion.summary: Blocked catalog listings exclude completed, cancelled and superseded work before counting and paging, including --all and restored ended shapes; historical blockers remain inspectable. Help, MCP descriptions, feature docs and use skill match the recorded Option B decision. Native/Rust regressions cover counts, pages, Proposed/Deferred preservation and cursor membership. Landed, pushed and installed the reviewed gated tree after fresh independent 1/1 acceptance and all four stores ready.
